notes.title: Happy (Early) Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32602886/736c13d4390e330b5251d78e96c84fd8c617b065.jpg[/img]

[h1]We're celebrating the spooky season with a limited-time 15%-off sale! [/h1]

In [b]Camp W[/b], you take the role of either Liliandra or Lysander, a runaway Witch trespassing in the realm of Humans. Cast spells, uncover mysteries, and -- [i]perfect for Halloween time[/i] -- gather around the campfire to hear spooky stories!
